headline: Two arrested, including Jubo Dal leader in alleged gang rape of woman
summary: The arrests follow allegations of a gang rape involving a housewife in Sonargaon, Narayanganj.
details: Police have arrested two individuals, including a Jubo Dal leader, in connection with the alleged gang rape of a housewife in Sonargaon.
The arrests were made following a complaint filed by the victim's family.
The suspects are currently in police custody as investigations into the crime continue.
The incident has caused significant concern in the local community of Sonargaon.
caption:
A Jubo Dal leader and another man have been arrested for the alleged gang rape of a housewife in Sonargaon.

Police have arrested two individuals, including a Jubo Dal leader, in connection with the alleged gang rape of a housewife in Sonargaon.

The arrests were made following a complaint filed by the victim's family.

The suspects are currently in police custody as investigations into the crime continue.

The incident has caused significant concern in the local community of Sonargaon.
